desc: Upgrade your kitchen with the GE Countertop Microwave Oven, a versatile 1.6 cu ft microwave designed to deliver fast, even cooking for everyday meals and family favorites. This 1150 watt microwave countertop combines generous capacity with powerful performance, making it ideal for reheating leftovers, cooking frozen meals, preparing snacks, and everyday meal prep. Sensor Cooking Controls automatically monitor moisture and adjust cooking time for consistently delicious results. Perfect for kitchens, apartments, dorms, offices, and shared living spaces, this stainless steel countertop microwave features one-touch express cooking, 8 convenience cook settings, an easy-to-read digital display, and electronic touch controls for simple operation. Manual and auto defrost functions help thaw frozen meat, poultry, and seafood evenly, while the removable glass turntable promotes consistent heating. A built-in child lock adds confidence for families and shared spaces. Whether you're looking for a GE microwave, General Electric microwave, countertop microwave oven, counter top microwave, stainless steel microwave, microwave oven countertop, kitchen microwave, large countertop microwave, family size microwave, 1.6 cu ft microwave, 1150 watt microwave, or a dependable microwave countertop, this GE microwave delivers the trusted performance, convenience, and everyday reliability shoppers expect from GE.
